steps.text: 7:00 PM \ Cloudy
Mid-Level Deck Hallway, Rhodes Island

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: ...Weird.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Where did Purestream go?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: She's not in the wastewater processing area, the pipe system monitoring room, or the bioengineering lab—

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: I don't even see her in the communal bath...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Landship Operator A
steps.text: Phew—This is awesome. A brand spanking new communal bath! What do they usually say about this stuff again? Technology really improves our lives.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Landship Operator A
steps.text: Automatic showers, always heated pools, steam saunas...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Landship Operator A
steps.text: That water massage bed is especially amazing. It changes its pressure and direction so finely it's like you're getting an actual massage!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Landship Operator A
steps.text: Should've expected nothing less from a new facility born from Weedy's bioengineering research... Feels like all the stress I've accumulated since I was born has disappeared!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Landship Operator B
steps.text: Hey, what stress do you even have? Actually, how long has it been since the last time you and I were on a field mission? All we've been doing is hanging around on the ship. I'm almost ashamed to enjoy this.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Landship Operator B
steps.text: A good number of field operators are coming back to the ship the next few days. That's the only reason Engineering has been rushing to finish renovating the bath.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Landship Operator B
steps.text: You and I, we're just riding on their coattails.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: It's just as I thought. The newly renovated bath's packed.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: And here I thought Purestream would be one of the first to hop in once it was open—

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: I mean, she and the others at Engineering spent months of hard work on it.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Wh-What?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: You're heading home? And you asked Closure for a long vacation?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Yeah... Actually, I've been on vacation since the day before yesterday. It's just that I've been spending my time in the records room...

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Sorry, Mul. Even though I promised we'd soak together in the bath for days after the renovation was over.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Oh... I-It's not a problem. I just thought it was a little sudden...

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: I mean, you were so busy not too long ago. You were cooped up inside the pipelines almost every day, inspecting the existing pipes and preparing the new drainage system for the renovation.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: You even said we should all take a bath together once you were done...

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Did something happen between you and the other engineers? Did you have a fight?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Did you forget to go through the disinfection procedures after coming back from the wastewater tanks, and Weedy—

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: No, that's not it. Everyone at Engineering has been nothing but kind, and Weedy in particular has been taking good care of me. She even asked me what kind of facilities I wanted to see in the communal bath!

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: I-Is it me, then? Did I do something to upset you so much that you're going home?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: O-Of course not! Actually, I should really thank you! There were a few times I was so busy I forgot to eat, and you brought me some Yanese wraps from the cafeteria!

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Mm, actually I just wanted some extras for mys— Uh, no, I mean... you seemed so busy, and I thought you should at least eat something.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: I know, I know~ The wraps you brought back were so tasty!

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Then why are you suddenly—

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Hm, it's here. So fast~

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Let me get the door.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Huh? What's here?

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Purestream, I have brought the requested data regarding Dusk City meteorological and hydrological observations and the rafting team.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: This data transfer has been authorized by the 'lovely Ms. Closure.' Please connect your terminal to me, and I will begin the transfer.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Alright! Let's see... I just need to set it down here, right?

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Correct. Please set it down as stably as you can—Please confirm.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Okay, I got it... These pictures are so clear! The river water seems to have a little too much silt. Looks like we'll need to keep an eye on the runoff volume and change in sediment discharge rates.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: But overall, based solely on the data we have on hand, this doesn't look so bad!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: The weather forecast looks good, too. It's practically sunny days all the way through~ Looks like this river rafting trip will go really well!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Thank you, Lancet-2! You've been a great help!

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: No need to thank me, but I must note that such requests are outside the scope of my ordinary medical duties.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: If you require any additional data, please file your request with the 'lovely Ms. Closure.'

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Rafting? Do you mean that famous Dusk River Rafting Team?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: I saw in the newspaper a few days ago that they're going to take on a feeder river somewhere downstream... I think it was called Wuwu River?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Supposedly nobody has 'conquered' it yet?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Right! Wuwu is the river that passes through my hometown. The name makes it sound murky, but the waters are actually very clear!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: The old men in the village said it's called the Wuwu because it's full of black pebbles on the bottom, making the whole river look black.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: So... Did you apply for your vacation to join the Dusk River Rafting Team at the Wuwu? You even looked up the meteorological and hydrological data...

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: N-No, that's not why! I don't know the first thing about rafting. It's not as simple as swimming, where you just have to keep paddling forward...

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Uh... Swimming is pretty difficult too, isn't it?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Swimming is just the basics! The people on the rafting team are much more amazing! They're all athletes who have rafted hundreds of times.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: As for the meteorological and hydrological data... I'm just a little worried about the river back home. It's been so long since I last went back. I don't know if the villagers and the people upstream have been taking good care of it...

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: I just hope that when the Wuwu shows up in the newspapers, it'll be in its purest form~

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Huh? Newspapers?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Oh, right! Take a look at these!

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Are these... pictures of the rafting team?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: That's right. This is the Guantou River, this is the Tufang River, and this is Shanyu River... All of them have graced the front page of the papers before!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: And now my hometown's Wuwu River is going to make it too! Of course I have to go back to witness this historic moment!

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Is... having your hometown's river show up in the papers really something to be so happy about? You must really love it there.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Of course! Don't you always pick your hometown's dishes in the cafeteria too?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Th-That's just because I think other cuisines don't add enough seasoning...

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Hm? They're not so bad... Back home, the villagers love making their food bland. It tastes just like the Wuwu River~

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Maybe that's why I think it's okay for food to be bland. It's good for your health~

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Tastes like the Wuwu River?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Yep! Back home, everyone cooked with the river water~

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Must be a really clean river...

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Hehe~ That's thanks to everyone working together to keep it that way. Once, we had some really dirty stuff floating down from upstream. It made everyone so mad!

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Huh? Was it caused by a Catastrophe?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: (Shakes head) Nope.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Then... industrial wastewater?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: No way... Even a village's river...?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: We put in so much effort to make sure our natural lakes and rivers aren't irreversibly damaged by Catastrophes, but we still can't escape industrial pollution.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: I get it. Industries need to expand too. It's not really something that we can do anything about... And if only a few contaminants make it into the rivers, then maybe nature itself can still purify them...

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: But if we don't bring the pollution under control, they're only going to accumulate, and then—

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: When you put at it like that, the rivers in these pictures are all maintained pretty well. Although you can still see the mark of Catastrophes...

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: I suppose our waterway management work has really made a difference.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Yep, yep! But my hometown's management of the Wuwu is even better!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: If the Wuwu River makes it into the newspapers with the rafting team, even more people will know that there are still such pure streams out there~

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: That way, maybe people will stop dumping all that dirty stuff into their rivers!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Wh-What's the matter? Did I say something funny?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: No... It just occurred to me all of a sudden that you have a really ambitious dream!

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: It's extraordinary.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: I-I'm not really doing anything! The rafting team chose to challenge the Wuwu River because they want to let more people know about the importance of protecting the rivers' ecosystems.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: And rafting's so dangerous and cool! Everyone's gonna be cheering them on—They're the ones making a difference.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: (This makes me wonder... What would the river bordering Jiangqi look like clean?)

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: (Was it once just as pure as these, years ago?)

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Mul. Mul? Something on your mind?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Ah! Sorry, I spaced out a bit...

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Oh, I almost forgot... I'm here to give you this—it's a ginger pear my parents sent me. They're a specialty from my hometown! I've been looking for you everywhere because I wanted you to have a taste.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Hmmhmmhmm~♪

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Soon, I'll be home to see the rafting team~ Yay!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Mul gave me a huge pear, too~ Yay!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: What kind of local specialty should I bring back for her as a souvenir?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: This...

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: The water that came out of that pipe seemed... just a little dirty, I think?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Looks like it's back to normal... Yeah, it tastes...
The next day...
9:30 A.M. \ Overcast
Rhodes Island Boarding Ramp

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Look what time it is... How come Purestream isn't here yet?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: *sigh* She seemed to really like that pear, so I thought I'd bring her a few more to bring home for her friends and family.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: But where did she go?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Weird, I don't see her anywhere... Did she leave already?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator A
steps.text: Man, I'm beat... From here on out, I'm turning down all field missions in Sargon! It's hot as hell there, and the local clients look down on me because of my tail. Sheesh...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator A
steps.text: Say, why don't we ever get missions in Siesta or Dossoles? If only we had some kind of observation mission that needed us diving in the waters there. You know I'd finish all my duties without issue.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator B
steps.text: You might as well just say you want to go swimming in the sea. But it's already fall. You'll get joint pain if you soak too long.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator A
steps.text: Little illnesses ain't nothing to be worried about. Big illnesses, well, there's no way to avoid them, so why worry either? Right... didn't the captain say the landship's bath house got renovated? I think I'll head there right now.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator B
steps.text: Forget it. I just saw the announcements on my terminal. They stopped the water.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Field Operator A
steps.text: Huh? No way—

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Did they say... they stopped the water?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Does that mean...
Meanwhile, in a dark corner of Rhodes Island—

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Okay, I finished checking all the pipes in this area. None of them show any major issues. Next up...

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Hm, if I remember correctly, there's still the area around the bath—
Do you need to check the communal bath's piping, too? It's just reopened.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Let's take a look there, just to be safe.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: This will do. All done!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: I'm not too familiar with the new pipe system's routing yet. There are so many twists and turns here. If I had to work on this by myself, who knows how long it would have taken me? Thanks for helping me with the directions, Weedy—

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: It's okay. I didn't do much...

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Really, though, the waterway system under the communal bath is so amazing~ It hasn't been that long, but there's already such a thick layer of dirt here, just like—

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Stop, stop, stop! No need to go into detail.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Looking at it now, the water usage lately has been quite high. Looks like the new bath's really popular~ There's even a natural water circulation system. I guess wishes really do come true!

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Huh? Wish? Did you toss a coin into the pool, too?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: O-Of course not! You can't throw coins into pools! No, you can't throw anything into pools!

spans.text: O-Of course not! You can't throw coins into pools! No, you can't throw

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: By 'wish,' I mean... Do you remember when you asked me what new facilities I wanted to see?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Actually, I'm not too familiar with bathing facilities... So I just thought it'd be nice if, just like the river back home, I could swim around freely. Flip and turn in the water as I want.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: It was just a whim since I knew there's limited space in the bath, but I didn't expect it to actually come true! Not to mention the circulation system is also helping keep it clean...

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: This is all thanks to you and everyone at the Engineering Department... Hehe, I'm so fortunate I get to live aboard Rhodes Island~

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: We can't take all the credit.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: If it weren't for you, we wouldn't have found all of the problems with the old piping system. Besides, haven't you been taking care of the cleaning during the construction?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Mhm~ It's what I'm good at, after all! It's nothing, really! N-Nothing at all!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: What's that noise...? Why is the transmission coming in so broken...?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: W-Weedy... What's my position right now?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: That's... the passage from the bath to the dorms.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: What's wrong? What happened?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: It looks like something's stuck here... It could get flushed out if there's a sudden surge of water.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Hm... It's kinda hard to get out...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: It's fine. Don't worry about it and come back. I noted the position, and I'll let the Engineering operators in charge of maintenance know to check on it later.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: It's okay. Let me take it out first, then we'll—

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Hm... That's a loud surge of water...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Did you get it out?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Purestream?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Purestream? Purestream! Hello? Can you hear me?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Oh no... She's not responding at all... Is it because of that sudden surge of water...?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: If the water pressure's too high, a sudden impact could...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Leaf, hurry! Head to the waterways and take a look—

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Phew—Wow, that hurts my mouth so much...

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: I didn't expect this to be so heavy...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Hey, Weedy! Don't worry. I've got it all taken care of. I brought the thing back with me!
At the entrance to the waterway, Purestream pokes her head out and waves what she removed from the pipes at the anxious Weedy.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: So... You weren't talking because you were holding it in your mouth?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Yep, the water was really strong, and I still had my staff and my cleaning tools, so I had to hold it with my mouth—It wasn't until I heard your voice through my terminal that I realized I couldn't talk.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Sheesh, you could've told me! I was so scared—

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Oh, it's okay. Don't worry! Thanks to my Arts, I can breathe normally underwater, and it keeps me from being affected by any impurities too. Though the taste of the wastewater is a little...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: That's not the problem!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Hehe... Sorry. I forgot.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Alright, as long as you're okay.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Now hurry up.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Mmhmm!
Purestream climbs up from the waterway, flicks off all the water on her, and steps onto the ladder.
Just as she is climbing onto the deck, she seems to suddenly slip and starts to fall backwards.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Whoa—

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: W-Watch out!
Before Purestream completely loses her balance, Leaf props her up from behind.
In the spur of the moment, Weedy reaches out and grabs Purestream's hand, helping her climb onto the deck.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Phew... That was close! I almost slipped...

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Thanks, Weedy... and Leaf!
Purestream notices that Weedy is holding her wrist tightly.
Right before their eyes, a drop of grayish water flows down Purestream's arm and onto Weedy's finger.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Um... Weedy, I'm a little dirty right now. I thought you didn't like...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Ah, it's fine.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: I'm not going to the lab today. This doesn't violate its sterile—

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Weedy... You're getting bumps on your skin. Maybe we should take you to Medical to get them checked out?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Oh... It's fine. Maybe it's just because it's a little cold here in the lower decks. Don't worry.

steps.name: Engineering Department Intern Operator
steps.text: I found them! They're here!

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Purestream! And... Weedy and Leaf?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Hm? Mul? What are you doing here?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: You're asking me...? Isn't today the day you're going home? Why are you still here—

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Didn't you say you were leaving at noon?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Yeah, but there's still a long time until...

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Huh?! It's almost ten?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: I didn't notice at all... Time goes by so fast~

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Hm? Purestream... You were leaving for home today?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: You could've told me sooner. I would've had the maintenance operators come fix this... Although they probably wouldn't have cleaned it as quickly and thoroughly as you.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: What... No way. You two worked all night?! Right up till now?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Ahaha...

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: I didn't expect time to go by so fast, either...

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Last night, I noticed there was a bit of wastewater flowing backwards through the pipes, so I thought I'd inspect it again before I left.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Good thing there weren't any major issues with the sewage system~

steps.name: Engineering Department Intern Operator
steps.text: But if it's just a little bit of wastewater flowing in reverse... That's not really urgent, is it? If we followed the regular maintenance schedule—

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: No, that won't do. We should trust our water treatment specialist.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: A-Actually... under normal circumstances, we really wouldn't have to take care of it so quickly.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: It's just... I heard we'll have more and more operators coming back from their field missions over the next few days. I'm sure everyone wants to try out the new bath, so I figured the water usage would shoot up in the short term.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: That's why I...

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: It's not a problem, Purestream. The thing you found jamming the waterway proves you made the right call.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: If there were a surge of water volume, the high water pressure could also flush any loose parts. If any were to get caught in the narrower pipes and cause grime to accumulate, it could lead to serious issues down the line.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Right, right! Back when I cleaned the river back home, we had situations like this plenty of times!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: You can't ignore even the slightest abnormality in the river. If you get a multi-day rain—

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Even the tiniest thing could unleash its mighty powers~

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Phew—The bath's so great! Now both the waterways and my body are sparkling clean~

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Taking a bath after work is the best!

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Purestream... I'm a little curious.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: How exactly did you fall asleep in that pool with the water currents?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: It gets pretty rocky in there, doesn't it? I tried it out for a little bit, but felt so dizzy—

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Huh? No way... It felt so good in there! Weedy spent a lot of time experimenting in order to recreate how an actual river moves!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Just soaking in it reminds me of the Wuwu back home.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: It's a good thing we still have time. Not only did I finish my work, I got to clean myself up in the new bath, too!

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: But if you're looking forward to going home so much, didn't it cross your mind that you could miss your ride? You might not have made it home before the rafting team takes on the Wuwu River!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Hmm... it did cross my mind, actually.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: It'd be a shame if I missed the rafting team, but the villagers are bound to have lots of pictures to show me!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: But I also wouldn't be able to go home with a carefree heart if I didn't check the landship's waterways before I left.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Each waterway is like a natural river to me. Even though it's in the ship right now, the water will return to nature at some point, no?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Even though Rhodes Island's water quality and wastewater disposal both exceed standards because of how strict Weedy is, it's always best to investigate as soon as you find something.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: I mean, 'dirty stuff' tends to accumulate~

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Besides...

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: When everyone's back from their field missions, they won't have to worry about having no water or dirty water. They'll get to soak in a hot bath without a thing on their minds. That's what my work means to me~

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Purestream...

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: I think...

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Oh... Looks like the car is here. Off I go now!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Thanks, Mul, for all the huge pears~! The villagers will love them!

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Yep! Have a nice trip! I look forward to seeing you and the rafting team in the same picture in the newspaper!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Huh? Th-That's not going to happen! You'll probably only see the Wuwu River...

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: But if I make it home before the rafting challenge begins, maybe I can still help everyone clean up the river first!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Hehe, I sure hope I'll be able to help the rafting team!

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: You're on vacation; get some rest!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Got it, Mul~

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: I'll bring you some of my hometown specialties, too!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: See you later~

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: *sigh*

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: There she goes...

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: I don't think she realizes just how extraordinary what she's doing is.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: It's no less noble than the rafting team, or the researchers.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: I'll tell her that directly when she gets back!

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: But... when is she coming back again?
